I0001-01.summary: Substring host check sends the GitHub service token to lookalike remote hosts

I0001-02.summary: cloneRepo sends service token to any remote URL containing "github.com"

texts.F18: `cloneRepo` passes the user-supplied `remoteUrl` straight to `gitAuthArgs` with the service token, so `git clone` sends the token to whatever host the URL names, as long as the URL contains the substring `github.com` anywhere.

I0002.summary: fetchCurrentUser failures reject loadDashboard and the dashboard never renders

texts.F03: `loadDashboard` awaits `fetchCurrentUser` and `fetchUserList` with no error handling. A failed request from `fetchCurrentUser` rejects the dashboard load, and the page never renders.

I0003.summary: Unvalidated repo ids let template and cache listing routes escape REPOS_DIR

texts.F12: The repository id is stored with no character or path validation and later used as a directory name. An id such as `../../etc` escapes the repositories directory on both the template route and the cache listing route; an absolute path such as `/etc` escapes it on the cache listing route.
texts.F14: The template route builds its base directory from the raw repository id.
